data.completion_memo: The Settings field now reads "Summary share of compaction (%)" and displays 20 by default. CompactionSettings.tsx imports DEFAULT_SUMMARY_SHARE instead of repeating the literal, so the panel fallback, the frontend mirror (compactionPlan.ts DEFAULT_SUMMARY_SHARE = 0.2) and the runtime constant (SUMMARY_BUDGET_SHARE = 0.2) cannot drift. Pinned tests updated: CompactionSettings.test.tsx expects 20 and the 20% read-out; compactionPlan.test.ts NaN fallback expects 20; Rust replacement-plan expectations recomputed for a 20% share (100k R 10,080/S 2,520; 262k 42,509/10,627; 1M 199,796/49,948; 32k floor 2,097/524) and the declared-output bound case moved to an 8,000-token output (R 241,744/S 8,000) because 64,000 no longer binds at 1M. The normative design markdown (aworkit.workflow_worker.context_compaction_budget) was saved through Adashi with the new default, ratio (0.8:0.2) and worked numbers, and docs/context-compaction.md updated to match. Verified: vitest settings-v2 compaction files 8/8 pass; cargo test --lib runtime::compaction 19/19 pass; pnpm tsc --noEmit clean. The source change is a default and label only; the runtime arithmetic is unchanged.
data.description: Settings UI: add "(%)" to the Summary share of compaction label so the 1-90 value is unambiguous, and change the default summary share from 0.382 to 0.20 in the Settings fallback, the frontend mirror (DEFAULT_SUMMARY_SHARE) and the runtime constant (SUMMARY_BUDGET_SHARE). Update the pinned tests and the normative design numbers, whose worked examples and default (38.2%) are derived from the share.
data.title: Compaction summary share: label "(%)" and default 20%
